generation_mode: New generation from a unified geometric construction description, without an input image.
design: Five matching nested rounded-diamond modules on a staggered lattice; closed contours, consistent spacing and fixed color roles.
prompt:
Create a brand-new premium abstract geometric pattern. Wide panoramic 2:1 canvas, approximately 1800 x 900. Flat professional graphic design with impeccable vector-like precision and very subtle gradients.

CONCEPT: a finished, authored "Lilac phase" lattice. One exact nested rounded-diamond module, repeated on ONE regular diagonal grid. A clear mathematical system, visually rich but calm.

COMPOSITION
Pale dusty-lilac background #ddd4e8. The left 48 percent stays entirely empty and uniform. The right half is filled by FIVE full or partial matching modules arranged as a staggered diamond lattice:
- One complete main module centered at 80% canvas width and 50% canvas height.
- Four identical neighboring copies diagonally around it, centered approximately at (64%,16%), (96%,16%), (64%,84%), (96%,84%).
The central module is fully visible. The four neighbors naturally continue beyond the top, bottom or right frame edges. These are intentional crops of the same large pattern, never half-finished shapes. This layout produces one coherent tessellated field with a rhythmic scalloped left boundary and elegant diamond-shaped negative-space channels. All modules have exactly the same size, orientation and construction. Do not invent any additional objects or decorative side strips.

MODULE CONSTRUCTION
Outer module diagonal approximately 31% of canvas width and 62% of canvas height. Its shape is a regular square rotated exactly 45 degrees, with four equal generous rounded corners. Every module is built from nested parallel offsets of a SINGLE master curve. Exact alignment, no skew, no changing centers.
From outside inward, the same fixed color sequence is repeated in all five modules:
1. A broad muted violet closed band, width 38 units.
2. A pale-lilac separation gap, width 12 units.
3. A mint closed band, width 22 units.
4. A pale-lilac separation gap, width 12 units.
5. A second narrower violet closed band, width 26 units.
6. A generous empty rounded-diamond aperture filled with the background lilac.
One extremely thin pale-citron accent, width 3 units, follows the mint band's inside edge continuously, identically on every module. The widths are a design ratio, not literal text in the artwork.
Every ring is a complete closed continuous contour. All corners share the same offset-derived radius system. The broad straight diagonal runs meet the rounded corners tangentially. Every boundary is smooth and crisp.

ADJACENCY RULE
Modules NEVER overlap or interlock. There are NO over-under crossings. A deliberate narrow channel of lilac background remains between ALL neighboring outer contours, including the diagonal saddle-shaped junctions. Minimum gap stays clearly visible. The grid step and module size are chosen so adjacent motifs form a tightly composed continuous PATTERN, not scattered icons, while every loop remains separate and traceable. No band touches or fuses with another module. This exact construction must remain true everywhere.

COLOR AND FINISH
Muted violet #a78bbd for the primary bands, restrained tonal variation toward #b6a2c9; muted mint #a0c6be as the secondary ring; pale citron #e8edba only as the fine accent; background #ddd4e8 between every contour. Each color has one permanent role. Extremely gentle gradients remain inside the bands, following their geometry consistently, without blurring the edges. Confident beautiful proportions, uniform rhythm, balanced negative space, professional editorial optical art. Smooth surfaces and crisp antialiasing.

FINISHED GEOMETRY
Exactly repeated modules, complete paths, mathematically consistent band widths, smoothly rounded corners, clean readable gaps. No random S-shaped strips, curls, tangles, broken or pinched bands, missing pieces, warped diamonds, stray tips, needles, tiny shards, width changes, asymmetrical repetitions, seams ending mid-shape, independent ornaments or arbitrary colored patches. No dimensional relief, extrusion, paper folds, cast shadows, beveled walls, plastic, noise, grain, texture, fog, circles, spirals, hexagons, typography, logos, watermark, frame, border or interface.
